attchmntText: Elgi Rubber Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication regarding the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Elgi Rubber Company Limited filed a notice with the National Stock Exchange regarding newspaper advertisements for its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The consolidated net profit after tax for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was 1,664.04 lakhs rupees, with earnings per share at 3.32 rupees. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the consolidated net profit after tax was 5,748.71 lakhs rupees, with earnings per share at 11.49 rupees. The standalone net profit after tax for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was a loss of 3,137.81 lakhs rupees. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the standalone net profit after tax was 1,185.16 lakhs rupees. The Board of Directors approved these results on November 12, 2026. The statutory auditors expressed an unmodified opinion on these results.

attchmntText: Elgi Rubber Company Limited has informed the Exchange about reversal of interest receivable from overseas wholly owned subsidiaries recognized during the quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Elgi Rubber Company Limited board approved the reversal of Rs.17.03 million interest receivable from overseas subsidiaries Elgi Rubber Company LLC USA and Borrachas e Equipamentos Elgi Ltda Brasil. This aims to reduce interest burden for the subsidiaries. The board also approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Statutory auditors issued an unmodified opinion. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was Rs.7,091.39 lakhs. Profit after tax was a loss of Rs.3,137.84 lakhs. Earnings per share was Rs.6.27 loss. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was Rs.12,934.76 lakhs. Profit after tax was Rs.1,185.16 lakhs. Earnings per share was Rs.2.37. The meeting was held on November 12, 2026.
